classification.difficultyReason: Calculate population standard deviation from frequency tables, including negative values and unequal frequencies.

content.prompt: Calculate the population standard deviation from these frequency tables to 2 d.p.

answer.worked:
Enter $x$: $1,2,3$ and frequencies: $1,1,1$ in 1-variable statistics. Select population standard deviation.
$$\begin{aligned}\sigma_x&=0.8164965809\ldots\\\sigma_x&\approx0.82\quad\text{(2 d.p.)}\end{aligned}$$

$$\begin{aligned}\sigma_x&=0.8164965809\ldots\\\sigma_x&\approx0.82\quad\text{(2 d.p.)}\end{aligned}$$
